text:
Which statement about rusting is correct?
Rust is anhydrous iron(II) oxide.
A
B
Oxygen is required for iron to rust.
C
Iron covered in grease rusts more quickly.
D
Iron rusts more quickly in the absence of air.

options.label: B
options.text: Oxygen is required for iron to rust.

options.label: C
options.text: Iron covered in grease rusts more quickly.

options.label: D
options.text: Iron rusts more quickly in the absence of air.
